reflection: The most robust signals are 3-day Apple-vs-peer gaps (helped 2022, 2023, 2025 with both models) but 2024's persistent trend regime repeatedly breaks them; single-day Apple candle features and QQQ-only features mostly failed. Multiplying the gap by a QQQ vol-ratio regime term worked (team trial +0.013), so regime-conditioning of the relative move is a productive direction. NVDA-MSFT spread helped only in 2025 and needed the volume partner. I will try conditioning on trend (to fix 2024) and a few different constructions: 10-day peer gap, gap interacted with Apple's own volume, and intraday-vs-overnight splits of peers.

lessons.name: aapl_rel_peer_5d_vol_scaled
lessons.lesson: Dividing the 5d peer gap by Apple vol made it a near-copy of the regime interaction factor and it only helped in 2025, so it added no new information.

lessons.name: nvda_qqq_volume_gap_smooth
lessons.lesson: Smoothing volume ratios over 5/60 days removed the short-lived volume spikes that RF used, leaving a slow regime proxy that hurt in three years.

lessons.name: aapl_vs_qqq_3d_gap
lessons.lesson: Apple vs QQQ 3d gap overlaps the peer-gap factor and persisted rather than reverted in 2024, giving a large loss that the peer version avoided.

lessons.name: qqq_range_expansion
lessons.lesson: QQQ range expansion is a non-directional volatility state that flipped sign between regimes and gave no edge.

lessons.name: aapl_peer_gap_regime_interaction
lessons.lesson: Scaling the Apple-vs-peer 3d gap by the QQQ short/long vol ratio gave a regime-aware relative signal that helped both models in three years, though 2024 still failed.

lessons.name: nvda_msft_lead_5d_spread
lessons.lesson: NVDA minus MSFT 3d momentum spread only worked in 2025 alone but combined with the volume ratio it gave real teamwork, suggesting it captures AI-leadership regimes.

factors.name: aapl_peer_gap_trend_filtered
factors.hypothesis: The peer gap reverts in choppy/down markets but persists in the 2024 uptrend; flipping its sign by the QQQ 20d trend direction should fix the 2024 failure.

factors.name: aapl_peer_gap_10d_vol_ratio
factors.hypothesis: A longer 10d gap scaled by Apple's own vol ratio captures slower mean reversion of Apple relative to peers and should be less duplicated with the 3d gap.

factors.name: peer_overnight_gap_mean
factors.hypothesis: Overnight gap of peers relative to Apple's own gap measures information already priced into peers at the open that Apple may catch up to later.

factors.name: aapl_intraday_vs_qqq_intraday
factors.hypothesis: Intraday (open-to-close) relative performance versus QQQ strips out overnight noise and may reflect flow-driven overreaction that reverses next day.

factors.name: aapl_volume_weighted_peer_gap
factors.hypothesis: The peer gap should revert more when it occurs on heavy Apple volume (capitulation/overreaction), giving an Apple-own volume conditioning that complements the market-regime interaction.

factors.name: nvda_msft_spread_qqq_vol_state
factors.hypothesis: The NVDA-MSFT leadership spread mattered mainly in high-vol 2025; scaling it by QQQ medium/long vol state makes it a regime-dependent partner for the existing spread.
